exam_scheme.note: The examination is conducted in accordance with the official Scheme and Syllabus published by WBPSC (Advt. No. 08/2024 & Advt. No. 01/2023). The Preliminary Examination consists of 200 objective MCQs (200 marks) as a screening test. The Main Examination comprises 6 Compulsory papers of 200 marks each (four MCQ papers on OMR and two conventional written language papers) plus one optional subject (two conventional papers of 200 marks each) for Groups A & B. Personality Test carries 200 marks for Groups A & B, 150 marks for Group C, and 100 marks for Group D.

financial_package.note: Salary package for Group A and Group B officers is fixed under Pay Level 16 of the West Bengal Services (Revision of Pay and Allowances) Rules, 2019 (ROPA 2019). Starting basic pay is ₹56,100.
financial_package.pay_source_label: WBPSC WBCS Advertisement (Advt. No. 01/2023) and West Bengal Services (Revision of Pay and Allowances) Rules, 2019 (ROPA 2019), Level 16
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated based on WBS (ROPA) 2019 Pay Level 16 entry basic pay of ₹56,100 with project constant 58% Dearness Allowance (effective 1 Jul 2025), House Rent Allowance (12% of basic pay under ROPA 2019), and Medical Allowance (MA ₹500/month). Deductions include West Bengal Professional Tax (PTax ₹200) and General Provident Fund / NPS contributions.
official_perks: State government executive residential accommodation or 12% House Rent Allowance (HRA)
Official vehicle with driver provided for official field inspection and administrative duty
Coverage under the West Bengal Health Scheme (WBHS) for cashless medical treatment of officer and eligible dependents
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) as per West Bengal Service Rules
Subsidized mobile and telephone allowances for executive officers

competition_benchmarks.note: Official statistics compiled directly from WBPSC announcements and merit lists. In the 2023 cycle (Advt. No. 01/2023), 244 total vacancies were reported (115 in Group A, 18 in Group B, 99 in Group C, 12 in Group D); 368 candidates qualified for Group A Personality Test, 57 for Group B, and 257 for Group C. In the 2022 cycle (Advt. No. 02/2022), 5,498 candidates qualified for the Main Examination, 128 candidates were recommended for Group C posts against 128 vacancies, and 713 candidates were called for the Group D Personality Test.
